reviews.text: Bought it for my sister in law, don’t know if she likes it or not yet. The only problem was with wide open packaging, the product literally dropped out of its box while transporting. It wasn’t sealed, it was opened, good thing is that the product was there, but it’s upsetting anyway.
reviews.zh: 買俾我嫂子嘅，暫時未知佢鍾唔鍾意。唯一嘅問題係包裝開口太大，運送途中件貨真係跌咗出個盒。冇封口，係開咗嘅，好在產品仲喺度，但無論如何都令人好唔開心。

reviews.text: My package came safe and wrapped and the delivery was very nice thank you I also wanna say the round lab toner is perfect I was really scared it would be a waste of money but no I have Been using this about 5 months and the toner is calming on my face and hydrating after I put it on.toner is like water so it just keeps your skin calm and doesn’t irritate,redness etc.
reviews.zh: 包裹安全送到而且包得好，送貨服務都好好，謝謝。我仲想講 round lab 爽膚水真係好完美，本來好怕會嘥錢，但係唔會。我用咗大概 5 個月，搽完之後塊面好鎮靜同保濕。爽膚水好似水咁，所以可以令你皮膚保持鎮定，唔會刺激、泛紅等等。

reviews.text: I bought this for the first time in store in Korea last year and loved it so much i repurchased it as soon as I was running low. It's extremly light weight and very pleasant on the skin it also absorbs very quickly. For me it also definitely had a clarifying effect. It's decently moisturising but I tend to have pretty dry skin so I use it in combination with a second toner that's not exfoliating and just moisturising. I whole heartedly reccomend this. The travel sized one is also very useful.
reviews.zh: 我去年第一次喺韓國嘅店買到呢個，一用就愛上，差唔多用完即刻回購。質地極輕，搽喺皮膚上好舒服，吸收得好快。對我嚟講，佢絕對有淨化肌膚嘅效果。保濕度都算唔錯，但我皮膚偏乾，所以會配搭另一支唔含去角質、純粹保濕嘅爽膚水一齊用。我真心推薦呢個。旅行裝都好實用。

reviews.text:
One of the most impressive aspects of this toner is its ability to deliver intense hydration. From the moment I apply it, my skin feels instantly refreshed and revitalized. Even on the driest of days, the toner provides a much-needed boost of moisture, leaving my skin feeling soft and supple.

I appreciate the gentle formulation of this toner. With only essential ingredients, it's suitable for even the most sensitive skin types.

Despite its rich hydration, the toner has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly into the skin. I love how it doesn't leave any sticky or greasy residue behind, making it perfect for use both day and night.

Another thing I love about this toner is its versatility. Whether applied with a cotton pad, used as a hydrating mist, or turned into a DIY sheet mask, it never fails to deliver exceptional results.

While the open-mouth bottle may not be the most convenient for some users, the benefits of the toner far outweigh any minor packaging issues.
reviews.zh:
呢支爽膚水最令人印象深刻嘅地方之一，係佢能夠提供強效保濕。搽上去嘅一刻，皮膚即時變得清新、有活力。即使係最乾嘅日子，爽膚水都會為肌膚提供急需嘅水分，搽完皮膚變得柔軟有彈性。

我好欣賞呢支爽膚水嘅溫和配方。成份只有必要嘅材料，連最敏感嘅膚質都適合用。

雖然保濕力強，但質地輕盈，可以好快被皮膚吸收。我好鍾意佢唔會留低任何黏笠或者油笠嘅殘留感，日頭同夜晚用都啱。

仲有樣嘢我好鍾意嘅係佢嘅多功能。用化妝棉搽、當保濕噴霧用、或者DIY成面膜用，效果一樣出色。

闊口瓶未必對所有用家嚟講最方便，但爽膚水嘅功效遠遠超越包裝上嘅小問題。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Toner + Lotion 200mL Special Set
reviews.text:
For both toner & lotion; great everyday baseline products in skincare routine for combo skin. Too much of anything can really mess with my skin’s overall health and these have a great Goldilocks formula. I have felt and seen a lot of my dead skin clear since using these two. It can lead to mild itchiness though if you don’t wash all the dead skin off your face during your next wash. 

Toner: consistency, look, and feel of water. Gives a good gauge of how thirsty my skin is based on how fast or slow my skin absorbs it. Gives me a good idea of the attention my skin needs and what I should add or remove in my next routine steps.

Lotion: I think the consistency is thinner than the usual facial lotion. It’s a runner; squeeze it out of the bottle with care or a lot will come out. Like the toner, it’s a good gauge of my skin’s moisture level. Since it’s thin and light, I can either put more or add cream to finish. This lotion has really helped toned down my oiliness.
reviews.zh:
爽膚水同乳液兩支都好；係混合性肌膚日常護膚程序嘅基礎好物。任何產品用太多都會搞到我皮膚嘅整體健康，呢兩支嘅配方就剛剛好。自從用咗呢兩支之後，我感覺到好多死皮都被清走。不過如果下次洗面嗰陣冇將所有死皮沖走，可能會有少少痕。

爽膚水：質地、觀感同觸感都好似水。根據皮膚吸收得快定慢，可以好好咁判斷到皮膚有幾乾。令我清楚知道皮膚需要咩照顧，之後嘅程序要加咩或者減咩。

乳液：我覺得質地比一般面部乳液薄。比較液態；擠出嚟嘅時候要小心，否則會擠太多出嚟。同爽膚水一樣，可以好好咁量度到皮膚嘅保濕程度。因為質地薄又輕，我可以再搽多層或者加埋面霜完成。呢支乳液真係幫到我控油。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Toner Jumbo Size 500ml (Free Gift: Toner 100ml)
reviews.text: ¡Ningún tónico cuida de mi piel cómo este! En un sólo paso hidrata intensamente mi piel, a la vez que ejerce un suave efecto exfoliante, ayudando a desprender las células muertas y las toxinas del interior de los poros. Contiene Pantenol, una vitamina muy beneficiosa para las pieles sensibles y que participa en la regeneración de la dermis. La Alantoína ejerce un potente efecto cicatrizante, que sanea la piel y ayuda a reducir el aspecto de marquitas y rojeces. Es un opción perfecta para mi piel sensible. Equilibra la piel, siendo capaz de humectar las zonas secas y controlar el exceso de grasa en mis zonas problemáticas, cómo frente, nariz... Este estupendo tónico contiene Pantenol, Alantoína y Betaína. Protege mi piel sensible y relaja las irritaciones y las rojeces. Su textura se adhiere sobre la piel y la deja fresca al instante. Por estas razones y más, he optado por el formato de 500 ml. Es un tónico realmente maravilloso, ¡mi favorito sin duda alguna! 😍💗💗💗😍
reviews.zh: 冇任何爽膚水可以好似呢支咁照顧我嘅皮膚！一步就幫我塊面強效保濕，同時有溫和嘅去角質效果，幫助清走毛孔入面嘅死皮同毒素。含有泛醇，呢種維他命對敏感肌膚非常有益，仲有助於真皮層嘅再生。尿囊素有強效嘅修復效果，可以治癒皮膚，幫助減淡印同泛紅。對我嘅敏感肌嚟講係完美嘅選擇。佢可以平衡肌膚，能夠為乾燥嘅部位保濕，仲控制到我嘅問題位（好似額頭、鼻子等）多餘嘅油脂。呢支好正嘅爽膚水含有泛醇、尿囊素同甜菜鹼。保護我嘅敏感肌，舒緩刺激同泛紅。佢嘅質地貼住皮膚，即時變得清新。基於以上種種原因，我揀咗 500 ml 嘅包裝。呢支爽膚水真係好正，絕對係我嘅最愛！😍💗💗💗😍

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Toner 500ml Special Set
reviews.text: This is my new go-to toner, especially since I live in a more humid climate. The texture is very watery but there is a hint of viscosity. My skin drinks up this toner like crazy so I just had to stock up on it. There are some gentle exfoliants in this product so it helps to also get rid of dead skin cells without causing any irritation whatsoever. It is the perfect summer/spring toner. My new holy grail! ^^
reviews.zh: 呢支係我新嘅必用爽膚水，尤其係因為我住喺比較潮濕嘅地方。質地好水但帶少少黏稠感。皮膚好似發癲咁吸收呢支爽膚水，所以我要囤貨。產品入面有溫和嘅去角質成份，可以幫助清走死皮，而且完全唔會刺激。係完美嘅夏天／春天爽膚水。我嘅新聖物！^^

reviews.text: This is such an awesome product, I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fast absorbing and hydrating toner. I usually use it right after cleansing the face and apply a generous amount of the toner. I will use about 3 to 4 layers and my skin feels refreshed and ready for the following steps of the routine. This product has helped so much to brighten my skin and it has helped a lot with the texture. You can see hoe mush my texture has improved from the pictures I attached. I have been using other products as well, but the only one thing that changed from my routine was the toner, so i do think this has helped the products absorb much better,
reviews.zh: 呢個產品真係好正，我強烈推薦畀任何想搵快速吸收同保濕爽膚水嘅人。我通常會喺洗面之後即刻用，然後搽大量嘅爽膚水。會搽大概 3 至 4 層，搽完皮膚覺得清新，可以準備進行之後嘅護膚步驟。呢個產品幫咗我好多提亮膚色，仲改善咗好多膚質問題。從我貼嘅相可以見到我嘅膚質改善咗幾多。我亦有喺用其他產品，但程序入面唯一改變嘅就係爽膚水，所以我真係覺得係佢幫助其他產品吸收得更加好，
